quarterly_data.quarter: QuEra Computing press release: Terra Quantum Joins the QuEra Quantum Alliance, Adding (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: QuEra: Libra, its first fault-tolerant quantum computer, is a 256 logical qubit, megaquop-class system targeted for availability on Amazon Braket in 2028, and QuEra has detailed a next-generation gigaquop-class fault-tolerant system. Software company Terra Quantum (TQ42 quantum software platform) joined the QuEra Quantum Alliance, whose membership has grown to more than 30 organizations since its August 2024 launch.
quarterly_data.figure: Libra: 256 logical qubits, targeted on Amazon Braket in 2028; alliance of more than 30 organizations
